Priya Sharma: Quick check — Apollo Health customer advocate is ready for launch next Tue. Need: final quote approval, short clips (30s/60s), transcript sign-off, and inbound lead routing rules. I'll paste the asset checklist.
Liam Chen: I can handle clip edits tomorrow. What time is the recorded call asset available?
Priya Sharma: Recording on Friday 11:00 PT. Liam — can you do 24h turnaround? :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Liam Chen: Yep 24h. Will tag deliverables in Drive.
Ava Morales: I'll draft the launch social copy. Need 2 approved customer quotes (short pull quotes). Sasha — legal ok on the NDA call excerpt and logo usage?
Sasha Patel: Quick glance: the customer approved a short quote but redacted a product name. I'll post inline redlines by EOD. Also fine with logo use per the signed MSA, just need brand alignment screenshot.
Priya Sharma: Copy of the quote from the transcript: "We've cut inference cost in half and latency is night-and-day." @Sasha — can that go live as-is?
Sasha Patel: Need to change "cut" to "reduced" and remove the explicit metric. Recommend: "We saw meaningful cost reductions and greatly improved latency."
Diego Ramos: On inbound routing — route leads from the promo URL to AE team B, tag source=apollo-launch, priority=high. Can we add a Slack zap to #sales-leads?
Priya Sharma: Yes please. @Diego can you add the zap and confirm CRM mapping? Also add a note to mark 'dedicated demo' for enterprise prospects.
RecordingBot: Transcript ready — /transcripts/2045-apollo-2024-08-23.txt
Priya Sharma: Posting checklist:
```
- Customer quote: legal-approved snippet (1)
- Short clips: 30s, 60s, 2m (chapters)
- Full transcript: QAed
- One-page exec summary + metrics (internal)
- Asset delivery: Drive links, release schedule
- Lead routing: zap + CRM mapping
- Press/legal: logo usage screenshot
```
Liam Chen: Linking draft clips in Drive in ~3hrs.
Ava Morales: I'll circulate social copy and CEO quote options for approval tomorrow morning.
Sasha Patel: Uploaded redlined quote here: https://drive.redwood/legal/apollo-redlines.docx. Approve by 5pm and I'll finalize.
Priya Sharma: If legal signs off by 5pm and clips land by 6pm, we can schedule Monday morning publish. Otherwise Tuesday. @everyone please react :thumbsup: when aligned.
Ava Morales: :thumbsup:
Liam Chen: :thumbsup:
Diego Ramos: :thumbsup:
Sasha Patel: :thumbsup:
Priya Sharma: Thanks — will follow up with calendar holds and final asset pack.
